assertions.name: variance_test_completed
assertions.source: COVERAGE: every one of the 5² = 25 (K_1*, K_2*) candidate pairs (K_3* = 6_1 fixed) produced a finite max/min variance over all 4 atoms ['D', 'T', '3He', '4He']. Expected value is |K_candidates|² from the declared candidate list, independent of the sweep's own output. Goes red if an atom χ-witness is missing (WARN + continue above) or a pair degenerates to inf. Best variance: 1.4888 at K_1* = 6_1, K_2* = unknot. Baseline (uniform Plancherel): 1.82. NOTE the hypothesis under test is NOT confirmed — the lepton-generation assignment (3_1, 5_1) does not minimise the variance; see `lepton_generation_assignment_rank_by_variance` in data.

description: Phase 5d.5b: variance test of K_k* candidate knots in the depth-stratified Frobenius-reciprocity binding formula. For each (K_1*, K_2*) candidate pair (× K_3* = 6_1 fixed per the catalog), assembles the FR-weighted binding contribution per depth and predicts B_atom. Reports the (K_1*, K_2*) pair minimizing the 1.82× variance residual from PR #801. Tests the knot-particle dictionary's lepton-generation assignment: K_1* = 3_1 = electron, K_2* = 5_1 = muon.
q0AnchorReason: recovered by transcription from this witness's own payload (key(s): parameters.q_0). No producer was re-run and no number changed; the pin was always recorded, under a non-canonical key.
